Two members (carrasco2004attention, carrascolingread2004attention) are the 2004 Nature Neuroscience article 'Attention alters appearance' (Carrasco, Ling & Read), DOI 10.1038/nn1194. But carrasco2019attention is a distinct 2019 reprint in the volume 'Blockheads!' (MIT Press), sole author Carrasco, with a DIFFERENT DOI 10.7551/mitpress/9196.003.0006. Different venue, year, author list, and DOI — it is a separate publication that should not be merged into the 2004 article cluster.
